newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: PRESS DIGEST - Philippine newspapers - Dec 9.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - Philippine newspapers - Dec 9.

text.p: These are the leading stories in Manila newspapers on Monday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- President Fidel Ramos says the country's annual growth rate of more than 7.0 percent is the highest in southeast Asia this year (ALL PAPERS)
- More than 40,000 fans flock to the HIStory concert of Michael Jackson in Manila's suburb of Paranaque (ALL PAPERS)
- A 19-year old Costa Rican student was crowned 1996 Miss Asia Pacific in a pageant held at Subic, a former U.S. naval base, last Saturday night (MANILA BULLETIN)
- All Asia Capital has projected a gross national product growth of 8.0 percent next year which it says will be supported by healthier exports and investments prospects (BUSINESSWORLD)
- The Central Bank lauds the plan of the finance department to repeal documentary stamp taxes on financial transactions. (BUSINESS DAILY)
- Malaysia's Wing Tiek Holdings Bhd is finalising the sale of its stake in the National Steel Corp, chief executive officer Edgardo Espiritu says (INQUIRER)
